text:
Predicates:
Created(x, y) ::: x created the game y.
MadeByJapanese(x) ::: x is made by a Japanese game company.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(x) ::: x sells more than one million copies.
InTop10(x) ::: x is in the Top 10 list.
Premises:
Created(japaneseGameCompany, legendOfZelda) ::: A Japanese game company created the game the Legend of Zelda.
∀x (InTop10(x) → MadeByJapanese(x)) ::: All games in the Top 10 list are made by Japanese game companies.
∀x (SellsMoreThanOneMillion(x) → InTop10(x)) ::: If a game sells more than one million copies, then it will be selected into the Top 10 list.
SellsMoreThanOneMillion(legendOfZelda) ::: The Legend of Zelda sold more than one million copies.
Conclusion:
MadeByJapanese(FIFA22) ::: FIFA 22 is made by a Japanese video game company.
